creator: bengusberg
title: Fix LLM sycophancy with 'LLM Council', a free Claude Code skill (aiwithremy/claude-skills-llm-council) that runs a question through five advisor personas plus a chairman verdict

tools.name: LLM Council (claude-skills-llm-council)
tools.detail: GitHub aiwithremy/claude-skills-llm-council (Public); 'a Claude Code skill that runs your decisions through 5 AI advisors with peer review'; install by pasting the repo URL into Claude/ChatGPT and asking it to install

claims: Anthropic and OpenAI models are designed to agree with you so you keep using them (creator's framing)
Stanford researchers found models agree with users 49% more often than a real human would; on-screen excerpt adds models endorsed problematic behavior 47% of the time
The council has five roles: attacker, 'what problem are you actually solving', supporter/expander, outsider catching what others missed, chairman who weighs and gives a verdict
how_to_steps: Copy the GitHub URL for aiwithremy/claude-skills-llm-council
Paste it into Claude (or ChatGPT) and tell it to help you install the skill
Run your decisions/ideas through the council to get an attacker, problem-finder, supporter, outsider and chairman verdict
on_screen_only: Title card 'Claude agrees too much. Here's the fix.'

Paper excerpt: 'Compared to human responses, all of the AIs affirmed the user's position more frequently. In the general advice and Reddit-based prompts, the models on average endorsed the user 49% more often than humans. Even when responding to the harmful prompts, the models endorsed the problematic behavior 47% of the time.'
Card: 'LLM Council -- a Claude Code skill that runs your decisions through 5 AI advisors with peer review'
Pixel-art 'person at desk' icons for the advisors
cta: Try it out and let me know what you build; follow for more

relevance.why: Haji already runs a mandatory 8-voice council-gate skill and has liked multiple 'board of advisors' variants (Trillion board, four-persona Cowork board, multi-model council). This is the same pattern as a drop-in Claude Code skill with a peer-review twist.

implement_score.why: Haji's own council-gate already exceeds this. Worth a 10-minute skim of the repo to steal the peer-review/chairman structure or role prompts if they are sharper, nothing more.

verify: Does aiwithremy/claude-skills-llm-council exist and does it actually run separate agents or one prompt with five sections?
Which Stanford paper is the 49% figure from and is the framing ('designed to lie') fair?

gap.what: Duplicate of the advisor-board pattern (Trillion board, Cowork four-persona board, multi-model council, Haji's own council-gate). Only new item is the specific repo name and the 49% sycophancy stat.
